company.name: simsim
company.shortDescription: Simsim is an e-commerce company enabling community opinion to sell products to thousands of micro-communities in India.
company.description:
Simsim is building a horizontal e-commerce platform keeping in mind the shopping behaviour of the Indian consumer and the need for trust and solutions in the local language. Lack of models catering to these needs of the customers has led to low overall penetration of online sales in the country.

The next wave of online commerce in India will be enabled by solving for these unmet needs of the customer. Simsim uses a unique combination of content and commerce to help customers discover the right products for themselves.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $8,200,000, or 53.07% of reported total funding.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,567,381 to $44,646,299, a 6.8x increase.
